methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected directly from each vendor's official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14. Auth0 annual billing is 11× monthly (≈8.33% discount; 1 month free). Clerk Pro annual rate is $20/mo vs $25/mo monthly (20% discount). Descope requires annual billing for Pro/Growth; no month-to-month rate published. WorkOS AuthKit is usage-based (per-MAU above 1M free); SSO/Directory Sync priced per connection per month; no flat monthly floor published for AuthKit alone. Stytch Pay As You Go has no base fee; charges are per-MAU above 10,000 free; monthlyUsd=0 reflects base cost of the smallest committed tier with usage metered above the free threshold. Amazon Cognito is pure pay-as-you-go per MAU; monthlyUsd=null for all plans as there is no flat floor (tier selection is per-account configuration, not a plan upgrade). Firebase Auth Blaze plan: no flat fee — charges only apply beyond the 50K MAU free threshold via Google Cloud Identity Platform metered rates; monthlyUsd=null. Supabase is included because Auth is a first-class feature with explicit MAU limits per plan. Okta Customer Identity Enterprise Base Platform lists a published $3,000/mo base; Workforce Identity per-seat prices are annual-only. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null — this is a non-telephony vertical.

enrichment.provenance: CORRECTED by verifier: the original enrichment UPGRADED hipaa from null to true, which is wrong and dangerous. The Firebase privacy/compliance page (firebase.google.com/support/privacy) lists Firebase Authentication as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR (Google acts as data processor under the Data Processing and Security Terms) but conspicuously OMITS HIPAA. Google's HIPAA Covered Products list does NOT include the Firebase-branded 'Firebase Authentication'; only 'Identity Platform' (the GCP-branded auth product) is a Covered Product. Firebase services not on the Covered Products list must be treated as NOT HIPAA-eligible for PHI. The product surfaced in this catalog is Firebase Authentication, so hipaa is REFUTED and set to false. soc2 and gdpr remain true (confirmed on the Firebase privacy page). The prior provenance's claim of GDPR via an 'AWS DPA' was a fabrication (AWS is unrelated to Google Cloud) and has been removed. Free Spark tier confirmed at $0 with 50K MAUs.
